value.title: Sjø, sjarm og smakfull nytelse ved havet! - Hummeren Hotell
value.description: Hotell, møterom og brygge med glasshus i Stavanger. Perfekt for bryllup, konferanser og events. Badstuebåt året rundt – velkommen ♥.
value.main_text_excerpt:
Bo ved bryggekanten
Sjø, sjarm og smakfull nytelse ved havet!
Hotell, møterom og brygge med glasshus. Perfekt for bryllup, konferanser og events. Badstuebåt året rundt – velkommen ♥
En forfriskende badstueopplevelse!
Trenger du et friskt avbrekk i hverdagen?
Ta turen innom oss i Tananger for en forfriskende badstueopplevelse!
Ingenting slår vel kombinasjonen av en varm vedfyrt badstue og et forfriskende bad som gir deg følelsen av å være levende og våken? Vår nydelig badstuebåt i Tananger havn er åpen året rundt!
Her kan du nyte sjøluft, bølgeskvulp og en atmosfære som gir ro i sjelen. Du møtes av ekte kystidyll – enten du slapper av på bryggen, nyter et måltid med havets smaker, eller lar solnedgangen male himmelen i vakre farger.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Hummeren Hotel Google profile: rating 4.1/5, 601 ratings.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: A hotel in a good location, but unfortunately the room I got was dirty and dusty. There was even a half empty bottle left in the room, and the bathroom was not clean either. The staff was correct. The breakfast and restaurant was mediocre. However, the fish soup can be recommended.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Definitely NOT Four Star! It is very much set up like a college dormitory. Very very old!!!!! I would not stay here.   The restaurant attached is good BUT EXPENSIVE. Fish soup and fish and chips $85.  No alcohol.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
Checked in just before midnight after a long day of traveling. What met me when I walked into the hotel room was, clogged sink in the bathroom, hair and dirty linen on the bed, trash can in bathroom not emptied and was full to the rim from the previous guests, brown stains on the side of the toilet and lots of dust and debris on the floor.

I went down to the reception to complain and I got a new room. None of the keycards worked so I had to go down again to get new ones, they didn’t work. The receptionist opened the room for me but didn’t fix the keycard problem. So here I am with no keycard. This new room is livable but not as clean as I would expect walking in to a hotel room. And the window/door doesn’t work properly so no fresh air during the night.

It’s also extremely old and should be upgraded.

1/10 do not recommend this place. I highly regret booking this disappointment of a room for that price.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
Visited the resturant for food and drinks.
Food is quite good and location is excellent for a meet up with friends and good company. The veranda is nice and shielded from any traffic, overlooking the water.

Service is friendly, but the overall quality of the service felt quite poor/unpolished. There is no table service outside.

The food menu is not representative of what they have in stock, with what seemed like an unending back and forth to find out what was actually on offer. The establishment really should consider updating the menu with what is actually for sale.
As for what was actually in stock was good.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Looks great from outside(needs paint badly) but room was miserable. Very outdated, no AC, bed horrible & just need a lot of help.... The view was ok- but was not of the Marina. It was hot, sun not blocked & just not good enough. The breakfast was great with a nice view & sunlight from the restaurant. The cook was a very dirty guy w dirty hair in very noisy boots walking back & forth - looking very angry.. So the thought of him making everything was uncomfortable to think about.
